evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across seven models and 1,035 cases from five datasets, average accuracy was 76.9% with answer options and 57.0% without them.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels.
